Let me analyze this question about the boll weevil.

The boll weevil (Anthonomus grandis) is a beetle that is historically and famously associated with devastating cotton crops, particularly in the southern United States. The word "boll" itself refers to the seed pod of the cotton plant. This pest feeds on cotton buds and flowers, causing severe agricultural damage. The boll weevil infestation in the early 20th century had a massive economic impact on cotton-growing regions.
